name: Elsewhere High
source:
Elsewhere High is an episodic, kinetic novel. It is an OELVN that began release in March of 2017, and is on going. 

The first two chapters of Elsewhere High were released simultaneously on March 31st, 2017, with subsequent chapters seeing release throughout 2017 and into 2018. 

The novel follows the story of a small group of students at the titular school who are transferred there after they each face expulsion for various reasons. The story is told through multiple points of view and chronicles the student's attempts of finding answers to the questions that arise about Elsewhere. 

The novel is available on the Steam platform.
